1.. City Council Study Session Regarding Options Available in Consideration of the Implementation of a Rent Stabilization Program

It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions:

1)	Review and discuss the Long Term Implementation Study and Study Session # 2 - PowerPoint Presentation prepared by the City’s consultant, RSG, Inc., (“RSG”);

2)	Provide for community input; and

3)	Provide feedback to City staff and RSG regarding desired next steps for the implementation of a long-term rent stabilization program.
